description: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for different training configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from approximately 95000 to 125000, with tick labels spaced every 10000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, with tick labels spaced every 0.2.  A magenta line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at iteration 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.35 at iteration 125000, exhibiting a rapid decline in the first 20000 iterations. A blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, starts at approximately 2.95 at iteration 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.35 at iteration 125000, also showing a rapid decline in the first 20000 iterations. An orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 2.95 at iteration 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.35 at iteration 125000, with a similar decline pattern. A red dashed line, labeled “Vanilla before post-training”, starts at approximately 2.65 at iteration 95000 and remains relatively constant at approximately 2.60 through iteration 125000.
